title: EAGLE: AI electrocardiograms to detect reduced heart function
summary: A randomized study across 120 primary-care groups at 45 sites evaluated neural-network alerts on electrocardiograms from 22,641 adults. The intervention produced five additional diagnoses of low ejection fraction per thousand patients, without a global increase in echocardiography use. The result concerns identification of dysfunction, not improved clinical outcomes.

evidence.tested: A cluster-randomised trial across 120 primary-care teams (22,641 adults) compared AI-ECG alerts with usual care on new low-EF diagnoses within 90 days.
evidence.unknown: Not reported in the abstract read; the trial measured diagnosis rather than clinical outcomes.
evidence.ai_role: Neural network analysed electrocardiograms and alerted clinicians to possible low ejection fraction.
